title: MIB Extends IFFI 2026 Media Accreditation Deadline till 4th November 2026
subtitle: Film Enthusiasts can also Register as Delegates to Experience a New World of Cinema
body_text: The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting has extended the last date for media accreditation for the 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI) 2026 till 4th November 2026. Media professionals planning to cover the festival, scheduled to be held in Panaji, Goa, from 20th to 28th November 2026, can submit their applications through the official Press Information Bureau (PIB) accreditation portal. Eligible media persons are advised to complete their registration and upload the required documents before the revised deadline. Registration Link: https://accreditation.pib.gov.in/eventregistration/login.aspx For queries, applicants may contact iffi.mediadesk@pib.gov.in. Accredited media professionals will have access to various festival activities, including: •           Film screenings •           Panel discussions •           Interactions with filmmakers and cinema professionals •           Networking opportunities •           Other activities related to festival coverage Media professionals who are already registered on the portal for previous edition (56th) of IFFI, can use the same credentials to log in and update their documents as required. Apply early to secure your place at one of Asia’s most celebrated film festivals, connect with voices shaping the world of cinema, discover stories beyond the screen and be part of IFFI’s vibrant celebration of filmmaking, creativity and culture. Furthermore, film enthusiasts who are not media persons may also register for IFFI as Delegates vide https://www.iffigoa.org/delegate-registration and enjoy the rich tapestry of films and other activities on offer at 57th IFFI 2026. About IFFI Born in 1952, the International Film Festival of India (IFFI) is South Asia’s oldest and largest celebration of cinema. Jointly hosted by the National Film Development Corporation (NFDC), Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, Government of India and the Entertainment Society of Goa (ESG), State Government of Goa, IFFI brings together filmmakers, legends and emerging voices from across the world. With international competitions, cultural showcases, masterclasses and tributes, the festival celebrates diverse stories, languages and cinematic traditions against the vibrant backdrop of Goa. For more information and latest details about the 57th IFFI 2026 please visit https://www.iffigoa.org/ . **** Mahesh Kumar/Aparajita Priyadarshini
